_about.description: Streams the Excalibur Oracle CDC feed from the single multiplexed Debezium landing table <catalog>.staging.oracle_excalibur_cdc (written by Debezium Server through the Zerobus gRPC sink) and applies SCD1/SCD2 change data capture into governed <catalog>.bronze tables. All three ingestion flows name the same source table, so the framework's source plane performs exactly ONE streaming read and fans it out to three consumers via bind() (the Single-Read DAG mandate); each flow then filters to its own Debezium topic with a dq_config drop rule, parses the envelope from the value JSON string column with an explicit schema_ddl, and sequences CDC by the Oracle SCN. Design and evidence: BT_Usecase/UC3/docs/UC3_MASTER_DOCUMENT.md.

ingestion_flows.source_description: Excalibur PHYSICAL_DEVICE CDC stream (SCD1): Debezium change events delivered by Debezium Server through the Zerobus gRPC sink into staging.oracle_excalibur_cdc, a MULTIPLEXED landing table shared by all three Excalibur tables. This flow filters to Debezium topic 'oracdc-excalibur.EXCALIBUR.PHYSICAL_DEVICE', parses the envelope out of the value JSON string column, and applies SCD1 into the governed bronze layer keyed on customer_id, subscriber_no, equipment_no, phy_seq_no, sequenced by the Oracle SCN. Clusters on __framework_hash_key because the 4-column primary key exceeds MAX_LIQUID_CLUSTERING_COLUMNS = 3 (BUILD_CONTRACT.md section 3 / capability map 2.3). Design and evidence: BT_Usecase/UC3/docs/UC3_MASTER_DOCUMENT.md.
